theorem.name: GlobalTTHessianTransportAndFierzPauliUniquenessReductionTheorem

part_A_global_fiber_hessian.statement: On E_TT=P_perp x_SO2 V2, every symmetric SO(2)-equivariant fiber Hessian is H_e=kappa_e Id_E. If the selected fixed point is nondegenerate and stable on this sector, then kappa_e>0.
part_A_global_fiber_hessian.scope: The global patching and unique form are proved. Positivity remains conditional on the upstream nondegenerate-stability hypothesis; no selected numerical Hessian is emitted here.

part_B_coordinate_transport.correction: The old symbol kappa_STF was used both for closure-strain stiffness and for the metric-coordinate EH coefficient. Those are different by a factor of four for the explicitly computed G=exp(2S) map.

hypotheses: a local parity-even Lorentz-covariant operator on a symmetric metric perturbation
at most two derivatives in the infrared principal action
linearized diffeomorphism invariance / off-shell Bianchi identity
part_C_action_uniqueness_reduction.operator: E_mn=Box h_mn-d_m div(h)_n-d_n div(h)_m+d_m d_n h+eta_mn div(div(h))-eta_mn Box h
part_C_action_uniqueness_reduction.TT_restriction: E_TT=Box h_TT on a flat background, and the corresponding Lichnerowicz block on an Einstein background
part_C_action_uniqueness_reduction.mass_statement: An algebraic Lorentz-invariant mass operator is incompatible with the same off-shell gauge identity unless its two coefficients vanish.
part_C_action_uniqueness_reduction.retarded_statement: Once a time orientation and globally hyperbolic Lorentzian background are selected, the normally hyperbolic TT operator has unique advanced and retarded Green operators. This does not select those Lorentzian inputs from MTT.

theorem.remaining_source_problem: Prove from the same selected MTT source that the physical action satisfies the four action hypotheses, chooses the displayed G observable, and fixes kappa_h plus the matter stress normalization. The revised proto action cannot supply that proof because it explicitly imports EH and Lorentzian data.

supersession.stale_gate: selected H_anchor to TT projection is missing
supersession.replacement: The global DG and TT projector now supply the projection explicitly. The remaining Hessian issue is action-source selection and scale, not an unknown 2x2 matrix.
supersession.normalization_correction: Metric and half-log strain Hessian coefficients must be distinguished by kappa_h=kappa_e/4.
